summaries.n-anthropic-ipo: Coins named for Anthropic's planned stock listing. Anthropic (ANT, Pump.fun): "$ANT The Meme Stock for the Anthropic IPO". Anthropic (ANT, StonkFun): "The Anthropic Ant." Anthropic (ANTS, Pump.fun): "As Anthropic eyes Wall Street, Ant Group dons a suit." Two more coins named Anthropic (Clanker V4: one on Base, 0xfff156..., one on Robinhood Chain, 0xcee339...) have no description; their name is the story. Posts of 2026-10-26 from Cointelegraph, The Kobeissi Letter and Wall Street Engine report that Anthropic filed an S-1 seeking a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT, and later posts report an amended S-1 and an IPO website. Dates from Codex: the ANT pool on StonkFun opened 2026-09-11, the ANT pool on Pump.fun 2026-10-19 and the ANTS pool on Pump.fun 2026-10-31 (after the filing); the Base Anthropic pool (0xfff156...) opened on 2026-11-02 and the Robinhood Chain Anthropic pool (0xcee339...) on 2026-11-03, both after it. The descriptions are the coins' own; none of the coins is shown to be connected to Anthropic. The first Base coin (0xf7b9cf...) is archived.
